units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 6. The record of examination and evaluation of the first parts of applications must contain:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 1) the date of examination and evaluation of the first parts and the identification numbers of those applications;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 2) information on the decision that a first part complies with the procurement notice or that an application is rejected, with reasons, specifying the provisions of this Federal Law and of the procurement notice with which the application fails to comply, and the provisions of the application that do not comply with this Federal Law or the procurement notice;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 3) the values awarded under each criterion for evaluating the first parts to applications found to comply with the procurement notice, where the notice establishes such criteria;
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 4) information on the decision of each procurement commission member participating in the examination and evaluation concerning each first part of an application;
units.label: Point 4 Part 6 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 5) information that the supplier (contractor, service provider) selection has been declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 52(1)(2) and (4) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 5 Part 6 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 7. No later than one hour after receiving the record of examination and evaluation of the first parts, the electronic platform operator shall send each participant that submitted an application a notice containing information:
units.label: Part 7 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 1) specified in paragraph 6(2) and (3) of this Article in respect of that participant’s first part of the application;
units.label: Point 1 Part 7 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 2) on the best offer specified in Article 43(1), point 3 or point 4, of this Federal Law contained in applications found to comply with the procurement notice, without identifying the participant that submitted it;
units.label: Point 2 Part 7 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 3) on the existence of applications found to comply with the procurement notice that contain information on goods originating in a foreign State, and of applications containing information on goods of Russian origin, without identifying the applicants. This information shall be sent where the contracting authority has included in the procurement notice under Article 42(1)(15) of this Federal Law information on a restriction or preference established under Article 14(2)(1), subpoints “б” and “в”, of this Federal Law for the goods, works or services that are the subject matter of procurement;
units.label: Point 3 Part 7 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 4) on the date, set in the procurement notice, of the procedure for submitting offers of the contract price or of the total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law), and its starting and ending times, set by the electronic platform operator according to the time zone of the contracting authority’s location.
units.label: Point 4 Part 7 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 8. Participants whose first parts have been found to comply with the procurement notice may, during the procedure for submitting offers of the contract price or the total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law), use the electronic platform to submit one offer of the contract price or total of unit prices (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law) (hereinafter also, a price offer). An offer equal to or higher than that contained in the third part of the application may not be submitted, nor may an offer equal to zero. Submission of an offer reducing the contract price or the total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law) below zero constitutes an offer of the fee payable by the participant for conclusion of the contract, which is stated as the contract price. Price offers shall be accepted for one hour.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 9. If a participant does not submit the offer provided for in paragraph 8 of this Article, the offer contained in the third part of its application is deemed its price offer.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 10. No later than one hour after completion of the procedure for submitting offers of the contract price or of the total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law), the electronic platform operator shall:
units.label: Part 10 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 1) prepare a record of submission of those offers, containing:
units.label: Point 1 Part 10 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: а) the date and the starting and ending times of the procedure for submitting offers of the contract price or of the total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law);
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 10 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: б) the price offers submitted by participants, indicating the identification numbers of their applications and the time each offer was submitted;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 10 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 2) send the contracting authority the second parts of applications whose first parts were found to comply with the procurement notice, together with the information and documents specified in Article 43(6)(2) and (3) of this Federal Law concerning the participants that submitted them.
units.label: Point 2 Part 10 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 11. No later than two working days from the day following receipt of the second parts of applications and the information and documents under paragraph 10(2) of this Article, but no later than the deadline for examining and evaluating the second parts set in the procurement notice:
units.label: Part 11 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 1) members of the procurement commission:
units.label: Point 1 Part 11 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: а) examine the second parts of applications and the information and documents forwarded by the electronic platform operator under paragraph 10(2) of this Article, and decide whether a second part meets the procurement notice requirements or whether the application must be rejected;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 11 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: б) evaluate the second parts of applications found to comply with the procurement notice against the criterion provided for in Article 32(1)(4) of this Federal Law, if that criterion is established in the notice;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 11 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 2) the contracting authority shall use the electronic platform to prepare a record of examination and evaluation of the second parts of applications. After the procurement commission members sign it with enhanced electronic signatures, a person authorized to act on behalf of the contracting authority shall sign it with an enhanced electronic signature and send it to the electronic platform operator.
units.label: Point 2 Part 11 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 12. When the second parts of applications are examined, an application shall be rejected in the following cases:
units.label: Part 12 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 1) failure to include in the application the information and documents required by the procurement notice under this Federal Law, except in the cases provided for by this Federal Law and except for the information and documents specified in Article 43(6)(2) and (3) of this Federal Law, or failure of such information and documents to meet the requirements in the notice;
units.label: Point 1 Part 12 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 2) failure to provide the information and documents specified in Article 43(6)(2) and (3) of this Federal Law, or failure of such information and documents to meet the requirements in the procurement notice;
units.label: Point 2 Part 12 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 3) the participant does not meet the requirements set in the procurement notice under Article 31(1) of this Federal Law, or the requirements set in the notice under Article 31(1.1), (2) and (2.1) of this Federal Law, where applicable;
units.label: Point 3 Part 12 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 4) the cases specified in Article 14 of this Federal Law: paragraph 4, point 1, subpoint “а” (except in the case provided for in point 5 of this paragraph), and point 2, subpoint “а”; and paragraph 5, point 1, subpoint “а” (except in the case provided for in point 5 of this paragraph), and point 2;
units.label: Point 4 Part 12 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 5) failure to provide the information and documents specified in Article 43(1)(5) of this Federal Law, if they are determined under Article 14(2)(2) of this Federal Law (where the procurement notice prohibits procurement of goods originating in a foreign State under Article 14(2)(1)(а) of this Federal Law);
units.label: Point 5 Part 12 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 6) the participant is found to be an organization specified in Article 2(4) of Federal Law No. 127-FZ of 4 June 2018 “On Measures to Influence (Counteract) Unfriendly Actions of the United States of America and Other Foreign States”, where the works or services being procured are included in the list determined by the Government of the Russian Federation under that point;
units.label: Point 6 Part 12 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 7) the cases provided for in Article 45(6) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 7 Part 12 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 8) inaccurate information is found in the procurement application;
units.label: Point 8 Part 12 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 9) inclusion of information on the participant’s offer specified in Article 43(1), point 3 or point 4, of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 9 Part 12 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 13. The record of examination and evaluation of the second parts of applications must contain:
units.label: Part 13 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 1) the date of examination and evaluation of the second parts and the identification numbers of those applications;
units.label: Point 1 Part 13 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 2) information on the decision that a second part complies with the procurement notice or that an application is rejected, with reasons, specifying the provisions of this Federal Law and of the procurement notice with which the application fails to comply, and the provisions of the application that do not comply with this Federal Law or the procurement notice;
units.label: Point 2 Part 13 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 3) the values awarded to second parts found to comply with the procurement notice under the criterion provided for in Article 32(1)(4) of this Federal Law, where that criterion is established in the notice;
units.label: Point 3 Part 13 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 4) information on the decision of each procurement commission member participating in the examination and evaluation concerning each second part of an application;
units.label: Point 4 Part 13 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 5) information that the supplier (contractor, service provider) selection has been declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 52(1)(2) and (4) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 5 Part 13 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 14. No later than one hour after receiving the record of examination and evaluation of the second parts sent under paragraph 11(2) of this Article, the electronic platform operator shall:
units.label: Part 14 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 1) send the contracting authority the price offers of participants whose second parts were found to comply with the procurement notice, together with the record provided for in paragraph 10(1) of this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 14 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 2) post the records provided for in paragraphs 6 and 13 of this Article in the unified information system and on the electronic platform.
units.label: Point 2 Part 14 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 15. No later than one working day from the day following receipt of the information and documents under paragraph 14(1) of this Article:
units.label: Part 15 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 1) members of the procurement commission:
units.label: Point 1 Part 15 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: а) evaluate the price offers against the criterion provided for in Article 32(1)(1) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 15 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: б) on the basis of the results of evaluating the first and second parts set out in the records provided for in paragraphs 6 and 13 of this Article, and the evaluation under subpoint “а” of this point, assign each application whose first and second parts comply with the procurement notice a rank in descending order of the advantage of the contract performance terms offered, taking account of regulatory legal acts adopted under Article 14 of this Federal Law. The application of the winner of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection shall be ranked first. If several applications offer identical contract performance terms, the application received earlier than the others offering the same terms shall receive the lower rank number;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 15 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 2) the contracting authority shall use the electronic platform to prepare the record of the results of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection. After the procurement commission members sign it with enhanced electronic signatures, a person authorized to act on behalf of the contracting authority shall sign it with an enhanced electronic signature and send it to the electronic platform operator.
units.label: Point 2 Part 15 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 16. No later than one hour after receiving the record of the results of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection sent under paragraph 15(2) of this Article, the electronic platform operator shall post:
units.label: Part 16 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 1) in the unified information system and on the electronic platform, the record of the results of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection;
units.label: Point 1 Part 16 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 2) in the unified information system, the information specified in Article 43(1)(1), subpoints “а” and “е”, of this Federal Law, the entry numbers in the unified register of procurement participants for those participants whose first and second parts were found to comply with the procurement notice, and the identification numbers of those applications. The information specified in this point shall not be published on the official website.
units.label: Point 2 Part 16 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 17. The record of the results of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection must contain the following information:
units.label: Part 17 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 1) the date on which the selection results were determined and the identification numbers of procurement applications;
units.label: Point 1 Part 17 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 2) for each application (each part of an application) submitted, the decision that it complies with the procurement notice or that it is rejected on grounds provided for by this Federal Law, with reasons, specifying the provisions of this Federal Law and of the procurement notice with which it fails to comply, and the provisions of the application that do not comply with the notice;
units.label: Point 2 Part 17 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 3) the values awarded under the evaluation criteria set in the procurement notice to applications whose first and second parts were found to comply with the notice;
units.label: Point 3 Part 17 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 4) the ranks assigned to applications in accordance with this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 17 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 5) information on conclusion of a contract at a price increased under Articles 28 and 29 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 5 Part 17 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 6) the decision of each procurement commission member concerning each application;
units.label: Point 6 Part 17 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 7) information that the supplier (contractor, service provider) selection has been declared unsuccessful in the cases provided for in Article 52(1)(1)–(4) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 7 Part 17 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 18. A participant that took part in the procurement may, after the record of the selection results is posted in the unified information system but no later than the date of conclusion of the contract, use the electronic platform to ask its operator for clarification of information in that record concerning the participant’s application. The operator shall forward the request to the contracting authority through the platform no later than one hour after receiving it. The contracting authority shall send the relevant clarification to the operator no later than two working days following receipt of the request for clarification of information in the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results. No later than one hour after receiving the clarification, the operator shall forward it through the platform to the participant that requested clarification of the information in the record of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection results.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 19. Where the procurement notice does not establish the criteria provided for in Article 32(1)(2) and (3) of this Federal Law, or where the contracting authority includes design documentation, standard design documentation or an estimate for major repairs of a capital construction facility in the description of the procurement subject matter under Article 33(1)(8) of this Federal Law, the electronic tender shall be conducted in the procedure established by this Federal Law subject to the following specific rules:
units.label: Part 19 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 1) the application consists of the second and third parts. The second part must also contain the information specified in Article 43(1)(2) of this Federal Law: subpoint “а” (except where the contracting authority includes design documentation, standard design documentation or an estimate for major repairs of a capital construction facility in the description of the procurement subject matter under Article 33(1)(8) of this Federal Law), and subpoint “б”. Paragraphs 3–10 of this Article do not apply;
units.label: Point 1 Part 19 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 2) no later than one hour after the application deadline, the electronic platform operator shall send the contracting authority the second parts of the applications submitted, together with the information and documents specified in Article 43(6)(2) and (3) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 19 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 3) the actions specified in paragraph 11 of this Article shall be performed no later than two working days from the day following receipt of the second parts, information and documents under point 2 of this paragraph, but no later than the deadline for examining and evaluating the second parts set in the procurement notice;
units.label: Point 3 Part 19 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Conduct of an electronic tender
units.text: 4) no later than one hour after receiving the record of examination and evaluation of the second parts under paragraph 11(2) of this Article, the electronic platform operator shall send the contracting authority the third parts of applications from participants whose second parts were found to comply with the procurement notice, and post the record provided for in paragraph 13 of this Article in the unified information system and on the electronic platform.
units.label: Point 4 Part 19 Art. 48
